_about: Exactly two experiment cards. Text fields hold {"en": …, "zh": …}; a plain string is used for both languages. Wording is editable; the tool fills quotes from the cited feedback records, {placeholders} from the data (see baseline_metrics), prerequisite checks and the readiness status. Citations use {"session": "S05", "field": "observed_behavior | user_statements | researcher_inferences"}. Never add keyword search volumes or virality claims — the copy check rejects them.

marketing_hypotheses.en: A visible before/after on the store page raises install intent the way the in-app preview raised purchase intent for one participant.
marketing_hypotheses.zh: 商店页面上可见的前后对比会提升安装意愿，就像应用内预览提升了一位参与者的购买意愿一样。

marketing_hypotheses.en: Stating the LiDAR requirement up front may lower installs but raise the share of installs that reach a qualified scan.
marketing_hypotheses.zh: 预先说明 LiDAR 要求可能会减少安装量，但能提高安装用户中完成合格扫描的比例。

marketing_hypotheses.en: Saying 'first suggestion free, full guide paid' before install reduces refunds caused by mismatched expectations.
marketing_hypotheses.zh: 在安装前说明“首条建议免费、完整指南付费”，可减少因预期不符导致的退款。

stop_rule.en: Stop when the {budget_cap} cap is spent or after 14 days. Stop early if any verified payment from this cohort stays undelivered for more than 24 hours, or if the refund share rises above {refund_rate}. If fewer than 20 first opens are reached (budget reach: {reach}), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.
stop_rule.zh: 花完 {budget_cap} 预算上限或满 14 天即停止。若该用户群有任何已验证付款超过 24 小时未交付，或退款占比升至 {refund_rate} 以上，则提前停止。若首次打开不足 20 次（预算可覆盖：{reach}），结果记为不确定，不对任何转化率下结论。

continue_rule.en: Roll the page out to all ASA traffic only if, with at least 20 first opens, qualified scans per impression beat the default page over the same period, qualified scan ÷ first open is at or above {qs_rate}, and no guardrail is breached.
continue_rule.zh: 仅当首次打开至少 20 次、同期每次曝光的合格扫描数优于默认页面、合格扫描 ÷ 首次打开不低于 {qs_rate}，且没有触发任何保护指标时，才把该页面推广到全部 ASA 流量。

target_problem.zh: 在 TikTok_KOC 流量中，{qs_rate} 的首次打开完成了合格扫描，{refund_rate} 的已验证购买被全额退款。内容应吸引有具体书桌问题、并持有 LiDAR iPhone 的人，并提前设定“先免费、后付费”的预期。

stop_rule.en: Stop when the {budget_cap} cap is spent or after 14 days. Pause a creator's video if its cohort's refund share rises above {refund_rate}. If fewer than 20 tracked first opens are reached (budget reach: {reach}), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.

continue_rule.zh: 仅当追踪到的首次打开至少 20 次、合格扫描 ÷ 首次打开高于 {qs_rate}、每次合格扫描的现金成本不高于 {cash_per_scan}，且没有触发任何保护指标时，才用同一脚本给新的创作者下简报。
